blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `getExistingPriceListsPriceIdsStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.
This step retrieves prices of price lists.

children.name: GetExistingPriceListsPriceIdsStepInput
children.description: The data to retrieve the prices of price lists.

children.name: GetExistingPriceListsPriceIdsStepOutput
children.description: An object whose keys are price list IDs and values are arrays of its price IDs.
